{{External|rs|rsc=Mithril Plate Mail Body|dw=Mithril Platebody}} {{Infobox Item |name = Mithril platebody |image = [[File:Mithril platebody.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = Provides excellent protection. |value = 5200 |weight = 8.618 |exchange = Yes |id = 1121 }} [[File:Mithril platebody detail.png|150px|left]] The '''mithril platebody''' is an armour used in [[melee]] with stat bonuses between [[Steel platebody|steel]] and [[Adamant platebody|adamant]] (not including the [[Black platebody|black]] and [[White platebody|white]] platebodies). It requires 20 [[Defence]] to equip and provides greater protection than a [[mithril chainbody]]. Like all [[Platebody|platebodies]], however, it gives a crippling negative bonus to the user's [[Ranged]] and [[Magic]] stats. Players with level 68 [[Smithing]] can make one by using 5 [[mithril bar]]s on an [[anvil]] while carrying a [[hammer]], granting 250 Smithing [[experience]]. Alternatively, they can be bought from a handful of armour shops. Smithing a mithril platebody is a requirement for the [[Ardougne Diary#Hard|Ardougne]] and [[Desert Diary#Hard|Desert]] [[Achievement Diary|Achievement Diaries]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -30 |arange = -15 |dstab = +46 |dslash = +44 |dcrush = +38 |dmagic = -6 |drange = +44 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = body |image = [[File:Mithril platebody equipped male.png|170px]] |altimage = [[File:Mithril platebody equipped female.png|170px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 68 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 250 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Mithril bar |mat1quantity = 5 |output1 = Mithril platebody }} ==Products== {{Uses material list|Mithril platebody}} ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClue}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Mithril platebody}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Mithril platebody}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The platebody's ranged attack bonus has been decreased from -10 to -15. }} {{Subject changes |date = 7 March 2005 |update = Mountain Daughter and Changes |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Mithril platebody detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Mithril platebody detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Mithril platebody (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Mithril platebody.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 ⁠–
